```{r}

patients |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "count") |>
  arrange(desc(count)) |>
  kable()
```

```{r patients-cols}
names(patients)
```

```{r patients-vis}
ggplot(patients, aes(x = first_race, fill = first_race)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_log10() 

ggplot(patients, aes(x = "", fill = first_race)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
ggplot(patients, aes(x = "", fill = vital_status)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")

```

```{r}
block_group <- patients |>
  count(census_block_group_fips_code)
```
```{r}
unique(patients$my_chart_status)
patients |>
  filter(is.na(patients$my_chart_status))
```

```{r}
dead_patients <- patients |>
  filter(vital_status == "Deceased")
unique(dead_patients$patient_birth_year_bin)

ggplot(dead_patients, aes(x = patient_birth_year_bin)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_log10()
```
